newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent firmer in an uptrend market.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent firmer in an uptrend market.

text.p: Brent crude oil futures in Asia firmed in late trading on Tuesday, in line with brokers' bullish expectations of a uptrend market.
October Brent on SIMEX last traded at $19.00 per barrel at 0840 GMT up seven cents, after from London overnight saw a six cent fall to close at $18.93.
November Brent on SIMEX was untraded but was quoted at $19.05/19.16.
London IPE had closed at $19.00 for November, after falling by 12 cents.
Brokers were waiting for the weekly American Petroleum Institute (API) data, due out late Tuesday.
A build in crude stocks was expected, but a slight drawdown in gasoline and continued high refinery utilisations rates should keep prices supported, they said.
NYMEX crudes on ACCESS last traded at $19.97, up six cents from New York's $19.91, which had fallen by 16 cents.
